# Get Card Details

This endpoint retrieves the details of a specific card by its ID.

## Request

- Method: GET
    
- URL: {{baseURL}}cards/{{Tarjeta1}}
    
- Query Parameters:
    
    - key (string): The API key
        
    - token (string): The authentication token
        

## Response

- Status: 200
    
- Content-Type: application/json
    
- { "id": "", "badges": { "attachments": 0, "fogbugz": "", "checkItems": 0, "checkItemsChecked": 0, "checkItemsEarliestDue": null, "comments": 0, "description": true, "due": null, "dueComplete": true, "lastUpdatedByAi": true, "start": null, "externalSource": null, "attachmentsByType": { "trello": { "board": 0, "card": 0 } }, "location": true, "votes": 0, "maliciousAttachments": 0, "viewingMemberVoted": true, "subscribed": true }, "checkItemStates": \[\], "closed": true, "dueComplete": true, "dateLastActivity": "", "desc": "", "descData": { "emoji": {} }, "due": null, "dueReminder": null, "email": null, "idBoard": "", "idChecklists": \[\], "idList": "", "idMembers": \[\], "idMembersVoted": \[\], "idShort": 0, "idAttachmentCover": null, "labels": \[\], "idLabels": \[\], "manualCoverAttachment": true, "name": "", "nodeId": "", "pinned": true, "pos": 0, "shortLink": "", "shortUrl": "", "start": null, "subscribed": true, "url": "", "cover": { "idAttachment": null, "color": null, "idUploadedBackground": null, "size": "", "brightness": "", "idPlugin": null }, "isTemplate": true, "cardRole": null, "mirrorSourceId": null}
